newsitem.title: USA: ICN settles lawsuit for cash and stock.
newsitem.headline: ICN settles lawsuit for cash and stock.

text.p: ICN Pharmaceuticals Inc said Thursday it has settled six claims from a 10-year-old class action lawsuit for about $14.5 million.
The company said it has agreed to pay $10 million in common stock and $4.5 million in cash. The settlement is subject to approval by the U.S. District Court in New York.
A jury rejected seven other claims on August 21 but was unable to reach a verdict on the other six claims and a mistrial was declared.

The plaintiffs had accused the company of engaging in securities fraud involving ICN's drug, Virazole. The lawsuit alleged the company made misleading or false statements concerning the safety and efficacy of the drug.
Virazole is used to treat infants hospitalized with severe respiratory tract infections caused by respiratory syncytial virus.
ICN Chairman, President and Chief Executive Milan Panic said it decided to settle the case to avoid a further costly and time consuming legal battle.
